impact_assessment.why: ADR-195's schedule is exact but exponential: at 8+ items it falls back to the shortest tour and loses items, so the shipped capability stops exactly where DeadlineWorld can still be measured.
impact_assessment.benefits: Exact deadline scheduling scales to 12 items; 4/5/6-item behavior stays byte-identical; the ablation becomes a sharper negative control at larger counts.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: internal helper and cap constant only, no CLI or default change; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: probe readout extends to larger item counts; regression: standing T1/T2/T3 pins must stay byte-identical.
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first equivalence tests against brute force on seeded layouts up to 7 items, explicit 8-12 item collection tests, the full suite and aikit 5/5.
